errors.text: The proposed workflow omits the target methodological innovation: replacing liquid-phase EAM with a moment tensor potential and replacing thermodynamic integration with free-energy perturbation.
Heating/cooling molecular-dynamics cycles do not by themselves provide the controlled solid–liquid free-energy equality needed for accurate melting temperatures, entropy of fusion, and heat capacity.
The claimed less-than-5% accuracy is unsupported by the cited evidence, which does not validate this workflow for refractory-alloy melting thermodynamics.
The hypothesis describes EAM or Lennard-Jones variants as machine-learned potentials, conflating fixed empirical functional forms with the high-fidelity MTP central to the target method.
